annotations.title: Keep a running server from falling asleep

description: Delays a running server's idle sleep by 5 minutes from now; it keeps being charged meanwhile. Use it while working on a server with no players online; to wake an asleep server use startServer. Fails with 409 if not running. Returns sleepAt.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: keepServerAwake
